name: SG21 locked structural reliability weighting
track: training-free W class-word; SD1.5; SA module 15; one-pass

rules.SG21-LM: raw local radius-1 mass, normalized within call
rules.SG21-LM-RANK: stable ascending local-mass ranks 1..8, normalized within call
rules.SG21-ENT: call maximum entropy minus head entropy plus epsilon, normalized within call
rules.SG21-DIST: inverse mean Euclidean distance plus epsilon, normalized within call

selection: unchanged five-fold train-threshold/held-out OOF screen; 4/5 votes, positive OOF, magnitude and class-stability guards; COCO transfer only
normalization: independent minmax at 64x64, bilinear to annotation resolution
external_context: historical SG18 W/P1 only, not candidate or selection reference
storage: per-image counts, event counts, head weights and descriptors; no images, attention matrices, Q/K/V, or propagated maps
excluded: no head subsets, combinations, temperatures, exponents, learned weights, COCO tuning, CRF, second pass, or extra windows
